name: Außerwieserhof
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Außerwieserhof is located at the edge of Neustift in the Stubaital, surrounded by meadows and rolling hills. The building is a traditional Tyrolean farmhouse operated as a guesthouse. Guests will find a simple, cozy atmosphere with authentically regional cuisine and clean, well-maintained rooms. The setting is peaceful and rural, making it ideal for those seeking tranquility and nature without sacrificing comfort.
